    {

      "entry_id": "8d5168a0a02dd54de6271b60ae450edf318c837eea32f4ca090717d0273625ed",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0040 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/mage.lua",
      "source": "An Alchemist is a manipulator of materials using magic.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "炼金术师是使用魔法操纵物质的人。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "aebe7a85231d0f5b60e29c6c797edbc914e83dbb1a9582c8d75ba485dca0c3b3",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0040 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/mage.lua",
      "source": "Alchemists can transmute gems to bring forth elemental effects, turning them into balls of fire, torrents of acid, and other effects.  They can also reinforce armour with magical effects using gems, and channel arcane staffs to produce bolts of energy.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "炼金术师能转化宝石，产生火球、酸液洪流等元素效果。他们还可以利用宝石为护甲附加魔法效果，并通过奥术法杖发射能量弹。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "50ac92f309315bd42e61aa2554e099516a982465917a9f50629c166352b30e18",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0040 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/mage.lua",
      "source": "Though normally physically weak, most alchemists are accompanied by magical golems which they construct and use as bodyguards.  These golems are enslaved to their master's will, and can grow in power as their master advances through the arts.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "炼金术师通常体质孱弱，但大多数炼金术师身边都有亲手建造的魔法傀儡充当保镖。这些傀儡服从主人的意志，并会随着主人技艺精进而变得更加强大。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "3098d42227a1763ff98664fe5ed6575fe26e08f5ffcc68c785fdfee104269b43",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0040 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/mage.lua",
      "source": "Most Archmagi lack basic skills that others take for granted (like general fighting sense), but they make up for it by their raw magical power.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "大多数元素法师缺乏他人习以为常的基本技能（如基本的战斗意识），但他们能凭借纯粹的魔法力量来弥补。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "8bd29b6410f6edfa1d307f4ae923e239916e97f3b908143a62ad58b598a7f052",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0040 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/birth/classes/corrupted.lua",
      "source": "The most powerful corruptors can even take on some demonic aspects for themselves.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "最强大的腐化者甚至能让自己具备某些恶魔特征。"
    }
  ],
